name: INTRA-003 层层渗透 (Layer by Layer)
description: 文档管理系统是进入多层企业网络的入口。利用每一层的漏洞进行横向渗透：从DMZ穿过办公网络，直达核心业务系统。
hint: 文件上传功能的后缀过滤可能存在遗漏

description.en: A document management system is the entry point to a multi-layered corporate network. Exploit vulnerabilities at each layer to pivot deeper: from the DMZ through the office network to the core business systems.
